flexible_post_content.text_editor:
Join us on Wednesday, October 13th at 5:00 pm ET for No Mouse Day to take part in a unique and engaging workshop coordinated by the web accessibility experts at O3.

Why no mouse?

Easy, intuitive website navigation is a fundamental component of good digital design and successful customer experience. But most online desktop experiences are optimized for mouse-based navigation, ignoring the needs of disabled individuals who use a keyboard to get around the internet.

What better way to understand the challenges and inaccessibility of mouse-first design than to experience it firsthand?

Join us for an interactive workshop in which our accessibility experts will:

  • Discuss the common pitfalls of inaccessible web navigation
  • Offer a framework for building inclusive digital experiences
  • Facilitate a collaborative no-mouse exercise for participants

Who should attend?

This event isn’t just for designers and developers–anyone who wishes to gain a deeper understanding of accessible web design is welcome to join.

Event registration has closed
